rows.grounds: compound catur-aṅga-bala in accusative singular neuter
compound stambha-kāraka in accusative singular masculine

items.question: Which four-limbed army is conquered by the vaṭuka who paralyzes camels?
items.inference: The vaṭuka's power overcomes both army and camels.
items.plain_english: Having conquered the four-limbed army, he is the paralyzer of camels.
